before: No op divided an inline content control or joined two of them. A paragraph split through a control copied its properties, tag and w:id included, to the tail.
after: splitContentControl { controlId, offset, tag } divides an inline control in its holder, the tail with the given tag and a fresh w:id; joinContentControls { firstId, secondId } moves the second control's content to the end of the first and removes the second. Both refuse a revision.
reason: Both ops reduce to one children replacement in the element holding the controls, which the journal already replicates; released participants receive the resulting shared state, never the new op kinds.
